title: 有馬記念の後に・吹き続け、どこまでも

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio wins the Arima Kinen, achieving a miraculous comeback.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She notes, however, that because Yamanin Zephyr surpassed her own Emperor first, this victory only equalizes the score.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She suggests that they settle the score at the next race, and Zephyr agrees. After all, the wind never stops blowing.
